title: Cellar Society Wine Dinner
seo_title: Cellar Society Wine Dinner in Ozark, MO – Dec 7
description: The December Cellar Society Wine Dinner is an evening of food with thoughtfully selected wine pairings, plus an optional Ugly Christmas Sweater Contest and holiday music and karaoke after dinner. Reservations are required, with happy hour at 6 PM and dinner at 7 PM. It takes place Monday, December 7, 2026, at Vineyard Market, 1759 W State Hwy J in Ozark, MO, and tickets are $75.
